name: hero-shop-reference-polish
description: Validate cohesive Hero City shop chrome, balanced feature-card geometry, safely framed premium companions, configured purchase controls, authoritative coin purchase, and close behavior.

steps.label: wait for runtime shop assets and regional prices

args.code: local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local cfg=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.GameConfig) local g=game.Players.LocalPlayer.PlayerGui.PunchWallHUD local a=g.PunchWallClientAutomation a:Invoke('OpenTab','Fists') task.wait(.25) local s=g.GameMenu.FunctionalHeroShop local scroll=s:FindFirstChild('ShopCatalogScroll') local compact=s:GetAttribute('ShopCompactLayout')=='MobileReadableRowsV1' local expectedLayout=compact and 'ReadableFullWidthRowV1' or 'StandardHalfWidthV2' local cards={} for _,item in ipairs(cfg.Fists) do table.insert(cards,s:FindFirstChild(item.name..'ShopCard',true)) end local standard=true local minHeight=999 for _,card in ipairs(cards) do standard=standard and card and card:GetAttribute('ShopCardLayout')==expectedLayout and card:GetAttribute('CatalogScrollable')==true minHeight=card and math.min(minHeight,card.AbsoluteSize.Y) or 0 end local scrollable=scroll and scroll.AbsoluteSize.Y>0 and scroll.AbsoluteCanvasSize.Y>scroll.AbsoluteSize.Y and s:GetAttribute('ShopCatalogScrollMode')==(compact and 'MobileReadableRowsV1' or 'FixedReadableCardsV1') local result={ok=#cards==#cfg.Fists and #cards==16 and standard and minHeight>=110 and scrollable,compact=compact,columns=s:GetAttribute('ShopCatalogColumns'),cards=#cards,standard=standard,minHeight=minHeight,scrollable=scrollable} assert(result.ok,H:JSONEncode(result)) return true

steps.label: Fists use sixteen readable cards in a scrollable catalog

args.code: local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local cfg=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.GameConfig) local g=game.Players.LocalPlayer.PlayerGui.PunchWallHUD local a=g.PunchWallClientAutomation a:Invoke('OpenShopPage','Premium') task.wait(.35) local s=g.GameMenu.FunctionalHeroShop local cards,preview,configured,wired,fit,priceClean=0,0,0,0,0,0 local first,last for index,pet in ipairs(cfg.PremiumPets) do local card=s:FindFirstChild(pet.name..'ShopCard',true) local action=card and card:FindFirstChild(pet.name..'Action',true) local viewport=card and card:FindFirstChild('PremiumPetPreview',true) local price=card and card:FindFirstChild('Price',true) if card then cards+=1 first=first or card last=card end if card and card:GetAttribute('PremiumPetPreviewReady')==true then preview+=1 end if viewport and viewport:GetAttribute('PreviewFit')=='BoundingSphereSafeV2' then fit+=1 end if price and not string.find(price.Text,'R$',1,true) then priceClean+=1 end if action and action.Active and action.Selectable and action:GetAttribute('PurchaseConfigured')==true and action:GetAttribute('GamePassId')==pet.gamePassId then configured+=1 end if action and action:GetAttribute('ShopActionBound')==true then wired+=1 end end local compact=s:GetAttribute('ShopCompactLayout')=='MobileReadableRowsV1' local desktopFeature=first and last and first:GetAttribute('ShopCardLayout')=='StandardHalfWidthV2' and last:GetAttribute('ShopCardLayout')=='FeaturedFullWidthV2' and last.AbsoluteSize.X>first.AbsoluteSize.X*1.95 and math.abs(last.AbsolutePosition.X-first.AbsolutePosition.X)<=3 local rows=first and last and first:GetAttribute('ShopCardLayout')=='ReadableFullWidthRowV1' and last:GetAttribute('ShopCardLayout')=='ReadableFullWidthRowV1' and math.abs(last.AbsoluteSize.X-first.AbsoluteSize.X)<=2 and first.AbsoluteSize.Y>=110 and last.AbsoluteSize.Y>=110 local feature=compact and rows or not compact and desktopFeature local result={ok=cards==3 and preview==3 and fit==3 and configured==3 and wired==3 and priceClean==3 and feature,compact=compact,cards=cards,preview=preview,fit=fit,configured=configured,wired=wired,priceClean=priceClean,feature=feature} assert(result.ok,H:JSONEncode(result)) return true

steps.label: Premium companions use exact previews and configured Game Pass actions

args.code: local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local g=game.Players.LocalPlayer.PlayerGui.PunchWallHUD local a=g.PunchWallClientAutomation a:Invoke('OpenShopPage','Boosts') task.wait(.2) local s=g.GameMenu.FunctionalHeroShop local compact=s:GetAttribute('ShopCompactLayout')=='MobileReadableRowsV1' local first=s:FindFirstChild('SpeedBoostShopCard',true) local second=s:FindFirstChild('DamageBoostShopCard',true) local layout=compact and 'ReadableFullWidthRowV1' or 'StandardHalfWidthV2' local standard=first and second and first:GetAttribute('ShopCardLayout')==layout and second:GetAttribute('ShopCardLayout')==layout and math.abs(first.AbsoluteSize.X-second.AbsoluteSize.X)<=2 local actions=true for _,key in ipairs({'SpeedBoost','DamageBoost'}) do local card=s:FindFirstChild(key..'ShopCard',true) local action=card and card:FindFirstChild(key..'Action') actions=actions and action~=nil and action.Active and action.Selectable and action:GetAttribute('ShopActionBound')==true and math.min(action.AbsoluteSize.X,action.AbsoluteSize.Y)>=44 end local footer=s.ShopFooter.SecureLabel.Text local truthful=compact and footer=='2 ITEMS' or not compact and string.find(footer,'BOOSTS',1,true)~=nil and string.find(footer,'2 ITEMS',1,true)~=nil local result={ok=standard and actions and truthful and s:GetAttribute('ShopCatalogItemCount')==2 and s:FindFirstChild('CoinBoostShopCard',true)==nil,standard=standard,actions=actions,compact=compact,footer=footer,items=s:GetAttribute('ShopCatalogItemCount')} assert(result.ok,H:JSONEncode(result)) return true

steps.label: two current coin-purchased Boosts use readable rows and truthful footer

args.code: local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local cfg=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.GameConfig) local g=game.Players.LocalPlayer.PlayerGui.PunchWallHUD local a=g.PunchWallClientAutomation a:Invoke('OpenShopPage','Robux') task.wait(.35) local s=g.GameMenu.FunctionalHeroShop local cards,configured,widthOk=0,0,true local width for _,product in ipairs(cfg.PremiumProducts) do if (product.shopPage or 'Robux')~='Robux' then continue end local card=s:FindFirstChild(product.id..'ShopCard',true) local action=card and card:FindFirstChild(product.id..'Action',true) if card then cards+=1 width=width or card.AbsoluteSize.X widthOk=widthOk and math.abs(card.AbsoluteSize.X-width)<=2 end if action and action.Active and action.Selectable and action:GetAttribute('PurchaseConfigured')==true and action:GetAttribute('ShopActionBound')==true and action:GetAttribute('ProductKey')==product.id and action:GetAttribute('ProductId')==product.productId and card:GetAttribute('ProductId')==product.productId then configured+=1 end end local result={ok=cards==4 and configured==4 and widthOk,cards=cards,configured=configured,widthOk=widthOk} assert(result.ok,H:JSONEncode(result)) return true

steps.label: Robux cards are equal and wired to configured products

args.code: local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local g=game.Players.LocalPlayer.PlayerGui.PunchWallHUD local a=g.PunchWallClientAutomation a:Invoke('OpenShopPage','Premium') task.wait(.2) local s=g.GameMenu.FunctionalHeroShop local h=s.ShopHeader local f=s.ShopFooter local tabs=0 for _,x in ipairs(s.ShopTabs:GetChildren()) do if x:IsA('TextButton') then tabs+=1 end end local tabNames=true for _,name in ipairs({'Fists','Premium','Boosts','Honor','Robux'}) do tabNames=tabNames and s.ShopTabs:FindFirstChild(name..'ShopTab')~=nil end local allTextFits=true for _,x in ipairs(s:GetDescendants()) do if (x:IsA('TextLabel') or x:IsA('TextButton')) and x.Visible then allTextFits=allTextFits and x.TextFits end end local chrome=h.Title.Text=='SHOP' and h:FindFirstChild('Subtitle') and h:FindFirstChild('HeaderRedRail') and h:FindFirstChild('HeaderCyanRail') and h:FindFirstChild('CloseShop') and f:FindFirstChild('CloseShopBottom')==nil and f:FindFirstChild('SecureLabel') and f:FindFirstChild('ServerLabel') and s.ShopTabs.PremiumShopTab:FindFirstChild('SelectedRail') local result={ok=not not chrome and tabs==5 and tabNames and allTextFits,chrome=not not chrome,tabs=tabs,tabNames=tabNames,allTextFits=allTextFits} assert(result.ok,H:JSONEncode(result)) return true

steps.label: header tabs footer and typography form one coherent system

args.code: local g=game.Players.LocalPlayer.PlayerGui.PunchWallHUD local a=g.PunchWallClientAutomation a:Invoke('OpenShopPage','Fists') task.wait(.2) return a:Invoke('InvokeShopAction','Boxing Glove')

steps.label: invoke visible boxing glove button handler

args.code: local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local p=game.Players:GetPlayers()[1] local owned=H:JSONDecode(p.RPGStats.OwnedFistsJSON.Value) return H:JSONEncode({ok=p.leaderstats.Coins.Value==320 and p.RPGStats.EquippedFist.Value=='Boxing Glove' and p.RPGStats.FistMultiplier.Value==1.8 and table.find(owned,'Boxing Glove')~=nil,coins=p.leaderstats.Coins.Value,equipped=p.RPGStats.EquippedFist.Value,mult=p.RPGStats.FistMultiplier.Value})

steps.label: close shop through header close handler

args.code: local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local g=game.Players.LocalPlayer.PlayerGui.PunchWallHUD task.wait(.2) return H:JSONEncode({ok=not g.GameMenu.Visible and not g.HeroShopDimmer.Visible,menu=g.GameMenu.Visible,dimmer=g.HeroShopDimmer.Visible})
